example.en: She comes up with a good idea.
example.zh: 她想出了一个好主意。

example.en: I can't put up with the noise.
example.zh: 我无法忍受噪音。

example.en: Students look up to their coach.
example.zh: 学生们敬佩他们的教练。

example.en: Never look down on yourself.
example.zh: 永远不要看不起自己。

example.en: We ran out of time in the test.
example.zh: 考试时我们用完了时间。

example.en: He gets along with everyone.
example.zh: 他和大家都相处融洽。

example.en: Let's get rid of the old sofa.
example.zh: 我们把旧沙发处理掉吧。

example.zh: 结果聚会很棒。

example.zh: 我弄不懂这条规则。

example.zh: 老师指出我的错误。

example.en: Don't bring up that topic again.
example.zh: 别再提那个话题。

example.zh: 团队逐步执行计划。

example.en: The students set up a science club.
example.zh: 学生们创建了科学社团。

example.en: He fell behind in math last term.
example.zh: 他上学期数学落后了。

example.zh: 跑快点,赶上队伍。

example.en: He ended up as a doctor.
example.zh: 他最终成了一名医生。

example.zh: 专注于你自己的试卷。

example.zh: 这份报告关注城市交通。

example.zh: 这个团队由五名学生组成。

example.en: Hard work results in progress.
example.zh: 努力带来进步。

example.en: This road leads to the beach.
example.zh: 这条路通向海滩。

example.en: The word refers to a kind of bird.
example.zh: 这个词指的是一种鸟。

example.en: Farmers rely on the weather.
example.zh: 农民靠天吃饭。

example.en: Girls account for sixty percent of the class.
example.zh: 女生占全班的百分之六十。

example.en: Her parents approve of her choice.
example.zh: 她父母赞成她的选择。

example.en: Don't argue with the referee.
example.zh: 别和裁判争论。

example.en: Our car broke down on the hill.
example.zh: 我们的车在山上抛锚了。

example.en: A fire broke out in the factory.
example.zh: 工厂里发生了火灾。

example.en: The internet brought about big changes.
example.zh: 互联网带来了巨大变化。

example.en: They called off the game because of rain.
example.zh: 他们因雨取消了比赛。

example.en: We should cut down waste.
example.zh: 我们应该减少浪费。

example.en: Some animals are dying out.
example.zh: 有些动物正在灭绝。

example.en: She gives away old books to the library.
example.zh: 她把旧书捐给图书馆。

example.en: Finally he gave in and said sorry.
example.zh: 最后他让步道了歉。

example.en: The teacher hands out the papers.
example.zh: 老师分发试卷。

example.en: Hold on to the rope at all times.
example.zh: 时刻抓紧绳子。

example.en: Look on the bright side: we learned a lot.
example.zh: 往好处想:我们学到很多。

example.en: The film lives up to its name.
example.zh: 这部电影名副其实。

example.en: The police look into the case.
example.zh: 警方调查此案。

example.en: She works hard to make up for lost time.
example.zh: 她努力弥补失去的时间。

example.en: The old writer passed away last year.
example.zh: 那位老作家去年去世了。

example.en: He put forward a new theory.
example.zh: 他提出了一个新理论。

example.en: Let's sort out the problems one by one.
example.zh: 我们逐个解决这些问题。

example.en: Her son will take over the shop.
example.zh: 她儿子将接管这家店。

example.en: My uncle took up painting at sixty.
example.zh: 我叔叔六十岁开始学画画。

example.en: He turned up late again.
example.zh: 他又迟到了。

example.en: Scientists work on new medicines.
example.zh: 科学家致力于新药研发。

example.en: The red star stands for hope.
example.zh: 红星代表希望。

example.en: In terms of price, this one is better.
example.zh: 就价格而言,这个更好。

example.en: He spoke on behalf of the class.
example.zh: 他代表班级发言。

example.en: The shop sells a variety of snacks.
example.zh: 这家店卖各种零食。

example.en: The library has a wide range of books.
example.zh: 图书馆藏书广泛。

example.en: Most students are in favor of the plan.
example.zh: 大多数学生支持这个计划。

example.en: Ms. Wang is in charge of the club.
example.zh: 王老师负责这个社团。

example.en: As a matter of fact, I love rainy days.
example.zh: 其实,我喜欢下雨天。

example.en: To be honest, the test was hard.
example.zh: 老实说,考试挺难。

example.en: They met by accident in Tokyo.
example.zh: 他们在东京偶遇。

example.en: In general, morning is best for reading.
example.zh: 总的来说,早晨最适合阅读。

example.en: On average, we read two books a month.
example.zh: 我们平均每月读两本书。

example.en: The twins have a lot in common.
example.zh: 这对双胞胎有很多共同点。

example.en: For the sake of safety, wear a helmet.
example.zh: 为了安全,戴上头盔。

example.en: In the long run, practice makes perfect.
example.zh: 从长远看,熟能生巧。

example.en: Some languages are at risk.
example.zh: 有些语言处于濒危状态。

example.en: The fire was soon under control.
example.zh: 火势很快得到控制。

example.en: The machine is out of order.
example.zh: 机器出故障了。

example.en: The map is out of date.
example.zh: 这张地图过时了。

example.en: Keep your notes up to date.
example.zh: 保持笔记更新。

example.en: She helped me, and I cooked a meal in return.
example.zh: 她帮了我,我做饭作为回报。

example.en: Book tickets in advance online.
example.zh: 提前在网上订票。

example.en: The teacher explained the rule in detail.
example.zh: 老师详细解释了规则。

example.en: In other words, we need more time.
example.zh: 换句话说,我们需要更多时间。

example.en: On the whole, the plan works well.
example.zh: 总体上,计划运行良好。

example.en: To some degree, hobbies shape our lives.
example.zh: 在某种程度上,爱好塑造我们的生活。

example.en: With the help of the teacher, I passed.
example.zh: 在老师的帮助下,我通过了。

example.en: The match stopped as a result of the storm.
example.zh: 由于暴风雨,比赛暂停了。

example.en: In addition to English, she speaks French.
example.zh: 除英语外,她还会说法语。

example.en: Apart from math, I like all subjects.
example.zh: 除了数学,我喜欢所有科目。

example.en: He runs every day, regardless of the weather.
example.zh: 无论天气如何,他每天都跑步。

example.en: Thanks to the coach, we won.
example.zh: 多亏教练,我们赢了。

example.en: In spite of the cold, they climbed on.
example.zh: 尽管天冷,他们继续攀登。

example.en: He got the job by means of hard work.
example.zh: 他靠努力得到了这份工作。

example.en: The school built a garden in honor of the old teacher.
example.zh: 学校建了一座花园纪念那位老教师。

example.en: He passed at the cost of his free time.
example.zh: 他牺牲空闲时间才通过。

example.en: We set out early in the hope of good seats.
example.zh: 我们早出发,希望能有好座位。

example.en: Many fruits, for instance apples, are sweet.
example.zh: 许多水果,比如苹果,是甜的。

example.en: All our efforts were in vain.
example.zh: 我们的努力都白费了。

example.en: Without doubt, she is the best singer here.
example.zh: 毫无疑问,她是这里最好的歌手。

example.en: The bridge was finished on schedule.
example.zh: 大桥按时完工。

example.en: Believe it or not, I met a film star.
example.zh: 信不信由你,我遇到了一位电影明星。

example.en: Let's face it: we need more practice.
example.zh: 面对现实吧:我们需要更多练习。

example.en: It occurs to me that we met before.
example.zh: 我想起我们之前见过。

example.en: What's worse, it began to rain.
example.zh: 更糟的是,天开始下雨了。

example.en: As far as I'm concerned, reading is the best hobby.
example.zh: 就我而言,阅读是最好的爱好。

example.en: There's no doubt she will win.
example.zh: 毫无疑问她会赢。

example.en: Please keep an eye on my bag.
example.zh: 请帮我看着包。

example.en: Don't lose heart; try again.
example.zh: 别灰心,再试一次。

example.en: He made up his mind to study abroad.
example.zh: 他下定决心出国留学。

example.en: She changed her mind at the last minute.
example.zh: 她最后一刻改变了主意。

example.en: A true friend keeps his word.
example.zh: 真正的朋友守信。

example.en: Take the safety rules seriously.
example.zh: 认真对待安全规则。

example.en: I have no idea where he is.
example.zh: 我不知道他在哪里。

example.en: Are you free tomorrow? It depends.
example.zh: 你明天有空吗?看情况。

example.en: Guess what! We won the first prize.
example.zh: 你猜怎么着!我们得了一等奖。

example.en: Hang in there; the final lap is near.
example.zh: 坚持住,最后一圈快到了。

example.en: Easier said than done, but let's try.
example.zh: 说来容易做来难,但我们试试。

example.en: The sooner, the better; book now.
example.zh: 越快越好,现在就订。

example.en: The long walk was well worth it.
example.zh: 长途步行非常值得。

example.en: As a rule of thumb, drink water before running.
example.zh: 经验之谈:跑步前先喝水。

example.en: The English test was a piece of cake.
example.zh: 英语考试是小菜一碟。

example.en: We watch films once in a while.
example.zh: 我们偶尔看电影。

example.en: Better late than never, he finally wrote back.
example.zh: 迟做总比不做好,他终于回信了。

example.en: Every coin has two sides, so think twice.
example.zh: 凡事有两面,三思而后行。

example.en: Keep practicing; practice makes perfect.
example.zh: 坚持练习,熟能生巧。

example.en: Actions speak louder than words, so show your plan.
example.zh: 行动胜于言语,拿出你的计划来。

phrase: when in Rome, do as the Romans do

example.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
example.zh: 入乡随俗。

phrase: kill two birds with one stone

example.en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
example.zh: 骑车上班一举两得。

example.en: The report is only the tip of the iceberg.
example.zh: 这份报告只是冰山一角。

example.en: A smile helps break the ice.
example.zh: 微笑有助于打破僵局。

example.en: Finals are coming; time to hit the books.
example.zh: 期末临近,该用功了。

example.en: I'm a bit under the weather today.
example.zh: 我今天有点不舒服。

phrase: cost an arm and a leg

example.en: That watch cost an arm and a leg.
example.zh: 那块表贵得吓人。

example.en: Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise.
example.zh: 错过公交反而是件好事。

example.en: He plays football to let off steam.
example.zh: 他踢球释放压力。

example.en: The two coaches see eye to eye on training.
example.zh: 两位教练在训练上意见一致。

example.en: Don't get cold feet before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前别临阵退缩。

example.en: City people are always on the go.
example.zh: 城里人总是忙个不停。

example.en: The doctors worked against the clock.
example.zh: 医生们争分夺秒地工作。

example.en: We're all in the same boat before the test.
example.zh: 考试前我们处境相同。

example.en: Practice academic writing in year three.
example.zh: 第三年练习学术写作。

example.en: He gave a speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 他在典礼上发表了演讲。

example.en: We do research in the science lab.
example.zh: 我们在科学实验室做研究。

example.en: We can draw a conclusion from the data.
example.zh: 我们可以从数据中得出结论。

example.en: Keep a diary to improve your writing.
example.zh: 写日记来提高写作。

example.en: Environmental protection starts with small things.
example.zh: 环境保护从小事做起。

example.en: Riding cuts your carbon footprint.
example.zh: 骑车减少碳足迹。

example.en: Global warming affects sea levels.
example.zh: 全球变暖影响海平面。

example.en: Wind is a renewable energy source.
example.zh: 风是可再生能源。

example.en: Artificial intelligence changes our lives.
example.zh: 人工智能改变我们的生活。

example.en: Clubs help students build social skills.
example.zh: 社团帮助学生培养社交能力。

example.en: Team spirit wins games.
example.zh: 团队精神赢得比赛。

example.en: Travel teaches us cultural differences.
example.zh: 旅行让我们了解文化差异。

example.en: Learn table manners before the dinner.
example.zh: 晚宴前学学餐桌礼仪。

example.en: Students love budget travel.
example.zh: 学生喜欢经济旅行。

example.en: The old town is a famous tourist attraction.
example.zh: 古城是著名的旅游景点。

example.en: We booked a hotel near the lake.
example.zh: 我们订了湖边的酒店。

example.en: Her sister is an exchange student in Canada.
example.zh: 她姐姐是加拿大的交换生。

example.en: He does volunteer work at the museum.
example.zh: 他在博物馆做志愿工作。

example.en: The job market needs new skills.
example.zh: 就业市场需要新技能。

example.en: A career plan helps you grow.
example.zh: 职业规划助你成长。

example.en: Work-life balance keeps you healthy.
example.zh: 工作与生活的平衡让你保持健康。

example.en: Sports help students manage stress.
example.zh: 运动帮助学生应对压力。

example.en: A balanced diet builds a strong body.
example.zh: 均衡饮食造就强健体魄。

example.en: Regular exercise improves sleep.
example.zh: 经常锻炼改善睡眠。

example.en: Talk to friends about mental health.
example.zh: 和朋友聊聊心理健康。

example.en: Every student should learn first aid.
example.zh: 每个学生都该学急救。

example.en: Use digital devices wisely.
example.zh: 合理使用电子设备。

example.en: She takes an online course on weekends.
example.zh: 她周末上在线课程。

example.en: Reading builds critical thinking.
example.zh: 阅读培养批判性思维。

example.en: I came across an old photo of our class.
example.zh: 我偶然翻到一张我们班的老照片。

example.en: The question came up in the meeting.
example.zh: 这个问题在会上被提了出来。

example.en: How did the accident come about?
example.zh: 事故是怎么发生的?

example.en: It all comes down to hard work.
example.zh: 这一切归根结底取决于努力。

example.en: The problem boils down to a lack of time.
example.zh: 问题归根结底是缺少时间。

example.en: The police crack down on unsafe driving.
example.zh: 警方严厉打击不安全驾驶。

example.en: We cut back on fast food last year.
example.zh: 我们去年减少了快餐的消费。

example.en: I need to catch up on sleep this weekend.
example.zh: 这个周末我得补补觉。

example.en: We all chip in to buy her a gift.
example.zh: 我们凑钱给她买礼物。

example.en: The wind died down in the evening.
example.zh: 傍晚风渐渐停了。

example.en: It dawned on me that I left my keys at school.
example.zh: 我突然意识到钥匙落在学校了。

example.en: You must face up to the mistake.
example.zh: 你必须勇敢面对这个错误。

example.en: Our travel plan fell through at last.
example.zh: 我们的旅行计划最终落空了。

example.en: The teacher gets the idea across with a picture.
example.zh: 老师用一张图把概念讲清楚了。

example.en: We get by on a little money each month.
example.zh: 我们每月靠一点钱勉强过活。

example.en: You will get over the fear of speaking English.
example.zh: 你会克服说英语的恐惧的。

example.en: The flowers give off a sweet smell.
example.zh: 这些花散发香甜的气味。

example.en: Let's go over the new words again.
example.zh: 我们把生词再过一遍吧。

example.en: The two sides iron out their differences.
example.zh: 双方消除了分歧。

example.en: I jot down the phone number on paper.
example.zh: 我把电话号码匆匆记在纸上。

example.en: He walks so fast that I can't keep up with him.
example.zh: 他走得太快,我跟不上。

example.en: The factory laid off fifty workers.
example.zh: 工厂裁掉了五十名工人。

example.en: The old man lives on a small pension.
example.zh: 老人靠微薄的养老金生活。

example.en: I look back on my school days with a smile.
example.zh: 我微笑着回顾我的学生时代。

example.en: We narrow down the choices to three.
example.zh: 我们把选择范围缩小到三个。

example.en: Please pass the message on to your classmates.
example.zh: 请把消息转告给你的同学们。

example.en: The city phases out old buses.
example.zh: 这座城市在逐步淘汰旧公交车。

example.en: I ran into an old friend at the airport.
example.zh: 我在机场偶遇一位老朋友。

example.en: We saw through his little trick at once.
example.zh: 我们一眼就看穿了他的小把戏。

example.en: Set aside ten minutes for reading each day.
example.zh: 每天留出十分钟阅读。

example.en: They set off for the mountain early in the morning.
example.zh: 他们一大早就出发去山里了。

example.en: She set out to build a small library for kids.
example.zh: 她着手为孩子们建一个小图书馆。

example.en: True friends stand by you in hard times.
example.zh: 真正的朋友在困难时支持你。

example.en: You should stand up for your own rights.
example.zh: 你应该维护自己的权利。

example.en: The headmaster will step down next year.
example.zh: 校长明年将卸任。

example.en: We step up training before the final game.
example.zh: 决赛前我们加紧训练。

example.en: Please sum up the story in three sentences.
example.zh: 请用三句话总结这个故事。

example.en: She takes on the hardest part of the work.
example.zh: 她承担了工作中最难的部分。

example.en: The police tracked down the lost bike in a day.
example.zh: 警方一天内就追查到了丢失的自行车。

example.en: The long trip wore me out.
example.zh: 漫长的旅行把我累坏了。

example.en: We wound up the party with a song.
example.zh: 我们以一首歌结束了聚会。

example.en: In light of the weather, we move the game inside.
example.zh: 鉴于天气原因,我们把比赛移到室内。

example.en: With regard to the plan, we need more details.
example.zh: 关于这个计划,我们需要更多细节。

example.en: In view of the cost, we choose the smaller one.
example.zh: 考虑到成本,我们选了较小的那个。

example.en: He got in by virtue of hard work alone.
example.zh: 他仅凭努力就考进去了。

example.en: Owing to the rain, the trip was called off.
example.zh: 由于下雨,旅行取消了。

example.en: Many problems stem from poor sleep.
example.zh: 许多问题源于睡眠不佳。

example.en: The word derives from an old French word.
example.zh: 这个词源自一个古老的法语词。

example.en: Heavy smoke gave rise to health problems.
example.zh: 浓烟引起了健康问题。

example.en: The delay resulted from bad weather.
example.zh: 延误是恶劣天气造成的。

example.en: He attributes his success to daily reading.
example.zh: 他把成功归因于每天阅读。

example.en: Exercise contributes to good sleep.
example.zh: 锻炼有助于良好睡眠。

example.en: The writer draws on his school life in the book.
example.zh: 作家在书中借鉴了自己的学生时代。

example.en: The report sheds light on the city's traffic.
example.zh: 这份报告阐明了该市的交通状况。

example.en: The new data casts doubt on the old idea.
example.zh: 新数据让旧观点受到质疑。

example.en: The law paves the way for cleaner air.
example.zh: 这部法律为更清洁的空气铺平了道路。

example.en: Parents play a role in forming habits.
example.zh: 父母在习惯养成中起着作用。

example.en: The room serves as our small library.
example.zh: 这个房间充当我们的小图书馆。

example.en: The trip hinges on the weather tomorrow.
example.zh: 这趟旅行取决于明天的天气。

example.en: The answer rests on two key facts.
example.zh: 这个答案依赖于两个关键事实。

example.en: Take the cost into account before you decide.
example.zh: 决定之前把成本考虑进去。

example.en: Take my advice into consideration.
example.zh: 把我的建议考虑一下。

example.en: Allow for traffic when you leave home.
example.zh: 出门时要把路况算进去。

example.en: She specializes in children's medicine.
example.zh: 她专攻儿科医学。

example.en: My cousin majors in computer science.
example.zh: 我表哥主修计算机科学。

example.en: The story is based on a real event.
example.zh: 这个故事基于真实事件。

example.en: The festival is rooted in old traditions.
example.zh: 这个节日植根于古老的传统。

example.en: Fast food is associated with weight gain.
example.zh: 快餐与体重增加相关。

example.en: Exercise is linked to better memory.
example.zh: 锻炼与更好的记忆力有联系。

example.en: There is a body of evidence for the idea.
example.zh: 有大量证据支持这个观点。

example.en: We had a series of tests last week.
example.zh: 我们上周有一系列测验。

example.en: It's a matter of time before she wins.
example.zh: 她获胜只是时间问题。

example.en: Music gives kids a sense of joy.
example.zh: 音乐给孩子们一种快乐感。

example.en: The farm uses a large amount of water.
example.zh: 这个农场使用大量的水。

example.en: The number of students is growing fast.
example.zh: 学生数量增长很快。

example.en: A number of parents joined the meeting.
example.zh: 若干位家长参加了会议。

example.en: The majority of families own a car here.
example.zh: 这里大多数家庭都有车。

example.en: Students are under pressure before exams.
example.zh: 学生考前承受着压力。

example.en: The city faces a challenge of clean water.
example.zh: 这座城市面临清洁用水的挑战。

example.en: The farm can't meet the demand for fresh milk.
example.zh: 农场满足不了鲜奶的需求。

example.en: The ads raise awareness of safe driving.
example.zh: 这些广告提高安全驾驶意识。

example.en: The internet bridges the gap between cities and villages.
example.zh: 互联网弥合了城乡差距。

example.en: Don't impose your ideas on others.
example.zh: 别把你的想法强加给别人。

example.en: Sleep has a big effect on memory.
example.zh: 睡眠对记忆力影响很大。

example.en: Tourism has an impact on small towns.
example.zh: 旅游业对小城镇产生影响。

example.en: The school takes steps to keep students safe.
example.zh: 学校采取措施保障学生安全。

example.en: Make an effort to speak English every day.
example.zh: 每天努力说英语。

example.en: Strike a balance between study and rest.
example.zh: 在学习和休息之间取得平衡。

example.en: Bear in mind that the shop closes at nine.
example.zh: 记住这家店九点关门。

example.en: Keep in mind that safety comes first.
example.zh: 牢记安全第一。

example.en: The sports meeting takes place in October.
example.zh: 运动会十月举行。

example.en: The new rule takes effect next month.
example.zh: 新规定下月生效。

example.en: You take a risk when you swim in the river.
example.zh: 在河里游泳是在冒险。

example.en: He overslept; as a consequence, he missed the bus.
example.zh: 他睡过了头,因此错过了公交车。

example.en: The new library is under construction.
example.zh: 新图书馆正在建设中。

example.en: The plan is still under discussion.
example.zh: 计划仍在讨论中。

example.en: I am out of practice with the piano.
example.zh: 我钢琴缺乏练习,手生了。

example.en: The top shelf is out of reach for the kids.
example.zh: 顶层架子孩子们够不着。

example.en: With daily practice, the goal is within reach.
example.zh: 每天练习的话,目标触手可及。

example.en: The fire was out of control at first.
example.zh: 火势起初失去了控制。

example.en: The nurse is off duty after eight.
example.zh: 护士八点后下班。

example.en: We eat at that restaurant once in a blue moon.
example.zh: 我们极少去那家餐厅吃饭。

example.en: An old classmate called me out of the blue.
example.zh: 一位老同学突然给我打来电话。

example.en: It's getting late. Let's hit the road.
example.zh: 天晚了,我们出发吧。

example.en: I am so tired. I'm going to hit the sack.
example.zh: 我太累了,要去睡觉了。

example.en: Stop beating around the bush and tell me the truth.
example.zh: 别拐弯抹角了,告诉我真相。

example.en: I bit the bullet and took the hard test.
example.zh: 我硬着头皮参加了那场难考。

example.en: He burned the midnight oil before the final exam.
example.zh: 期末考前他熬夜苦读。

example.en: She was on cloud nine after winning the prize.
example.zh: 获奖后她欣喜若狂。

example.en: The scientist stays down to earth after big success.
example.zh: 这位科学家在大成功之后依然脚踏实地。

phrase: the ball is in your court

example.en: I have said sorry. The ball is in your court now.
example.zh: 我已经道歉了,现在该你表态了。

example.en: You will get the hang of swimming soon.
example.zh: 你很快就会掌握游泳的窍门。

example.en: The new worker is learning the ropes.
example.zh: 新员工正在熟悉门道。

example.en: Let your hair down at the weekend party.
example.zh: 在周末派对上好好放松一下。

example.en: The family works hard to make ends meet.
example.zh: 这家人努力工作以维持生计。

example.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the boat on the sale.
example.zh: 抓紧,不然就错过这次特卖了。

example.en: I am still on the fence about the trip.
example.zh: 对于这次旅行我还在犹豫。

example.en: Don't worry. I'm just pulling your leg.
example.zh: 别担心,我只是逗你玩。

example.en: Read between the lines of her letter.
example.zh: 体会她信中的言外之意。

meaning: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草

example.en: The lost key was the last straw for him.
example.zh: 丢了钥匙成了他爆发的最后一根稻草。

example.en: Never throw in the towel before the last minute.
example.zh: 最后一分钟之前绝不认输。

example.en: His laugh added fuel to the fire.
example.zh: 他的笑声火上浇油。

example.en: Time flies when we read good books.
example.zh: 读好书时时光飞逝。

example.en: Take an umbrella. Better safe than sorry.
example.zh: 带上伞吧,小心驶得万年船。

phrase: where there is a will there is a way

example.en: Where there is a will there is a way.
example.zh: 有志者事竟成。

example.en: Look before you leap when you choose a school.
example.zh: 选学校时要三思而后行。

example.en: No pain no gain. Keep training every day.
example.zh: 不劳无获,每天坚持训练。

phrase: the early bird catches the worm

example.en: The early bird catches the worm, so get up early.
example.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃,所以早点起床。

phrase: don't put all your eggs in one basket

example.en: Don't put all your eggs in one basket when you invest.
example.zh: 投资时别孤注一掷。

example.en: He spends his pay fast. Easy come easy go.
example.zh: 他花钱很快,来得容易去得快。

phrase: out of sight out of mind

example.en: Out of sight, out of mind. Keep the fruit on the table.
example.zh: 眼不见心不烦,把水果摆在桌上吧。

example.en: The task is hard. Even so, we will finish it.
example.zh: 任务很难,即便如此我们也要完成。

example.en: The answer is far from right.
example.zh: 这个答案远非正确。

example.en: The trip was anything but boring.
example.zh: 这次旅行绝非无聊。

example.en: It is nothing but a small mistake.
example.zh: 这只不过是个小错误。

example.en: The room is no more than ten square meters.
example.zh: 这个房间仅有十平方米。

example.en: He speaks English, not to mention Chinese.
example.zh: 他会说英语,更不必说中文了。

example.en: The kid can't walk, let alone run.
example.zh: 这孩子还不会走路,更别提跑了。

example.en: The old bike is worth ten yuan at best.
example.zh: 这辆旧自行车充其值十块钱。

example.en: At worst, we walk home in the rain.
example.zh: 最坏的情况,我们冒雨走回家。

example.en: We met on Sunday, or rather Sunday morning.
example.zh: 我们周日见面,更确切说是周日上午。

example.en: He is a doctor, that is to say, he works in a hospital.
example.zh: 他是医生,也就是说,他在医院工作。

example.en: On second thought, I will take the bus instead.
example.zh: 转念一想,我还是坐公交车吧。

example.en: The dish looks new. Give it a shot.
example.zh: 这道菜看着很新奇,尝一口吧。

example.en: Can I have a word with you after class?
example.zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗?

example.en: Please send your answer in writing.
example.zh: 请以书面形式发送你的答复。

example.en: Copy the sentence word for word.
example.zh: 逐字地抄写这个句子。

example.en: The plan looks good on paper.
example.zh: 这个计划理论上不错。

example.en: The climbers came home safe and sound.
example.zh: 登山者们安然无恙地回家了。

example.en: We watch a film now and then.
example.zh: 我们时不时看场电影。

example.en: The bus goes back and forth between the two towns.
example.zh: 公交车在两镇之间来回行驶。

example.en: People came from far and wide for the festival.
example.zh: 人们从四面八方赶来参加节日。

example.en: He trains day in and day out for the race.
example.zh: 他为比赛日复一日地训练。

example.en: She built the club from scratch.
example.zh: 她从零开始建立了这个社团。

example.en: Bit by bit, the city becomes greener.
example.zh: 一点一点地,城市变得更绿了。

example.en: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
example.zh: 突然,灯全灭了。

example.en: He quit smoking for good last year.
example.zh: 他去年永久戒烟了。

example.en: He is a kind man at heart.
example.zh: 他本质上是个善良的人。

example.en: She is quiet by nature.
example.zh: 她天生文静。

example.en: I found the old ticket by chance.
example.zh: 我偶然发现了那张旧车票。

example.en: The card was made by hand.
example.zh: 这张卡片是手工做的。
